ios.desc: The Groov Club app provides the user with the ability to search for and book appointments with local providers of personal services, such as hairdressers, and household needs such as house cleaning. These providers provide their services at the client's home or place of business, saving them time and hassles. Clients search for providers in their area not only by type of service provided but by quality based on reviews by other clients. The app is free for download; providers pay no fees aside from their initial application fee. Clients pay a booking fee based on a small percentage of the service fee being booked and can earn reward points redeemable within the app.

quotes.text:
Groov Club allows people to book services conveniently to their homes and/or at the business location. These services include hair services of all kinds, beauty, automotive, health & wellness, Tutoring, Lessons, Therapy, and much more! No more lines, calls, and waiting for your services!

For Businesses and Pro’s we offer them a platform where they can grow their business anyway they want. The app allows them to set their prices, services offered, profiles, galleries, radius of visibility, and memberships if they offer any.

Check us out here: 
IOS Download Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/groov-club/id1565184111
